result.reason: The edit appropriately reduces the notice period to 30 days and preserves the annual renewal structure, but it does not fully reach the playbook position. It adds neither the preferred 60-day renewal reminder nor an operative cap on renewal price increases; it therefore also fails to establish the fallback requirement that increases be capped at 5%. The change is otherwise narrow and professionally drafted, although the existing language continues to frame notice as termination rather than expressly as non-renewal.
